requirements: R1: Remove the incorrectly committed design check mockups and build artifacts under the target directory from the codebase
R2: Replace the nondeterministic Math.random() fallback key in the CatalogSearch.svelte frontend component with a deterministic identifier

slices.title: Clean incorrectly committed artifacts and fix CatalogSearch nondeterministic key
slices.jtbd: When implementing this patch for this epic, I want to remove the invalid mockups and target artifacts and replace the nondeterministic fallback key, so that the PR hygiene is restored and the frontend is deterministic.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given the codebase has committed mockups in .eneik/records and target build artifacts, When the patch is applied, Then these invalid files are removed from the repository.
Given the CatalogSearch.svelte component assigns fallback keys, When a search result lacks an ID, Then a deterministic identifier is used instead of Math.random().
Given the changes are complete, When all relevant tests are executed, Then the system behaves correctly and QA coverage passes.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Reduce nondeterministic fallback key usage to 0%

requirements: R1: Configure the server explicitly to bind to port 18080 via a server port property or application argument
R2: Serve a 200 OK status on the /health path by mapping a controller or modifying the actuator base path
R3: Add a verification command, script, or test to confirm the application binds to the port and the health endpoint returns a successful response

slices.title: Fix launch port configuration and health endpoint response
slices.jtbd: When implementing this patch for this epic, I want to explicitly set the server port to 18080 and serve the /health endpoint, so that the application container starts cleanly and health checks pass.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given the service container starts, When the port is explicitly configured, Then the application binds correctly to port 18080.
Given a request is made to /health, When the application processes it, Then a 200 OK status is returned.
Given the configuration is complete, When the verification command runs, Then the deployment is verified successfully without errors.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Increase health check pass rate on startup to 100%
